name: pulse-verity
description: Read crypto reference-price observations and verify their signed receipts. Try limited BTC, ETH and SOL samples without an API key. Five read-only tools with local signature verification.
long_description:
This extension gives Claude five read-only tools: current crypto index prices, batch reads, asset discovery, recorded prints near a requested time, and signature verification. Successful current-price and recorded-print receipts, and successful rows in batch responses, include ECDSA P-256 signatures over the canonical symbol, exact price, at and grade fields. Catalogue rows and surrounding metadata are unsigned. A valid signature authenticates these signed fields, not price accuracy or freshness. Coverage, cadence, batch limits and print retention vary; a catalogue entry does not guarantee a current price.

Limited BTC, ETH and SOL samples require no API key. For broader requests, create a developer account at https://thepulse.markets/developers and configure your own key. Access and usage are subject to your developer account's allowance and current availability.

The signature verifier runs locally after retrieving the published public-key ring, which is cached. Verification depends on the matching key remaining published; this tool cannot verify a historical receipt whose key is no longer in that ring.

pulse_api_key.title: Pulse API key (optional)
pulse_api_key.description: Optional. Leave blank for limited BTC, ETH and SOL samples. For broader requests, create a developer account at https://thepulse.markets/developers and configure your own key. Access, coverage and usage allowances depend on your account and current availability.

tools.name: get_index_price
tools.description: Request a current signed price receipt for one crypto symbol, subject to availability

tools.name: get_index_batch
tools.description: Read a bounded batch with signed successful rows and per-symbol errors; account limits apply

tools.name: list_index_assets
tools.description: Discover one page of the unsigned asset catalogue with coverage status and measured cadence

tools.name: get_settlement_print
tools.description: Request the recorded signed print nearest a time within bounded retention; check its time difference

tools.name: verify_print
tools.description: Verify canonical price fields locally with ECDSA P-256/SHA-256 using the fetched, cached public-key ring
